thun min bsam mi khyab yin/ ༄༅/ /man ngag thob pa yin na bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa bsgom ste/de'i tshul la sngon 'gro rtsa lam sbyong ba dang*/

tei:div.tei:p: thun min bsam mi khyab yin/ ༄༅// man ngag thob pa yin na bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa bsgom ste/ de'i tshul la sngon 'gro rtsa lam sbyong ba dang*/ dngos gzhi bsam mi khyab kyi 'od gsal la 'jug pa'o// dang po ni zhar byung gi rdzogs rim gyi mjug tu/ lus gnad bsrang*/ rlung ro bsal/ rang gi lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar nang dmar/ sbom phra srin mdzub tsam yar sna spyi gtsug tu zug pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ gnyis ka'ang dbu ma las sum 'gyur gyis phra ba/ yar sna spyi gtsug nas gug ste sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ gsum ka'i mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad sbubs gcig tu gyur pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam gsal btab/ de la sems gtad pas thugs ka nas sku chung ngu zhig nar gyis chad/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig rtsa g.yas ro ma'i nang nas yar dmar khyug gis byon/ sna g.yas pa'i sgor slebs pa dang*/ de las de 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad la khyab/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing thugs dam bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs shing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ de thams cad tshur 'dus sngar gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ rlung nang du rngub pa dang sna g.yon pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ rkyang ma'i lam brgyud lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsam zhing rlung ci thub tu bzung ngo*// de lta bu lan bdun sogs ci nus su bya/ gnyis pa ni/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ yan lag thams cad 'od du zhu nas khog pa la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od dmar po'i phung por gyur/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod du 'byon pa la rings pas yar byon rim bzhin dbu ma dbu gtsug dang*/ ro rkyang gnyis kyang zhabs mthil la thim pas je chung du gyur cing*/

phyi dbyibs kyi lus kyang rim par thim/ spyi gtsug tu byon pa dang rtsa dang lus lhag ma ma lus pa thim/ de'i rkyen gyis rang sems rnal 'byor ma rtsal po che'i mda' nam mkha' la 'phangs pa bzhin mkha' spyod du gshegs te/ 'od gsal stong nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsams la gsal stong zung 'jug gi dbyings su mnyam par bzhag slar yang nam mkha' nas rang sems rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de nyid thol gyis byung*/ rang gnas su babs pa dang phyi'i lus dang rtsa sogs kyang sngar bzhin grub par bsams/ de lta bu tshar gcig gam/ bdun nam/ gsum sogs skabs dang sbyar la bya'o// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
